column2: Wait for a fresh scooter connection.
column3: Počkajte na nové pripojenie ku kolobežke.
column4: Wait for a new connection to the scooter.

column2: Read PIN status, then pair this phone.
column3: Prečítajte stav kódu PIN a potom spárujte tento telefón.
column4: Read the PIN code status and then pair this phone.

column2: Configure and enable the dashboard PIN before pairing for proximity unlock.
column3: Pred párovaním pre odomknutie pri priblížení nastavte a zapnite PIN na riadidlách.
column4: Before pairing for proximity unlock, set and turn on the PIN on the handlebars.

column2: PIN status did not arrive. Tap Read PIN status to try again.
column3: Pri tomto pokuse neprišla žiadna odpoveď so stavom kódu PIN. Skúste to znova klepnutím na „Načítať stav PIN“.
column4: During this attempt no response with the PIN code status arrived. Try again by tapping "Load PIN status".

column2: PIN state is unavailable on this firmware.
column3: Stav kódu PIN nie je v tomto firmvéri dostupný.
column4: The PIN code status is not available in this firmware.

column2: PIN settings require the owner profile.
column3: Nastavenia kódu PIN vyžadujú profil vlastníka.
column4: The PIN code settings require an owner profile.

column2: Bond this phone before enabling proximity unlock
column3: Pred zapnutím odomknutia pri priblížení spárujte tento telefón
column4: Before turning on proximity unlock, pair this phone

column2: Enable a configured handlebar PIN before proximity unlock
column3: Pred zapnutím odomknutia pri priblížení zapnite nastavený PIN na riadidlách
column4: Before turning on proximity unlock, turn on the set PIN on the handlebars

column2: Read the PIN state, then apply proximity unlock.
column3: Prečítajte stav kódu PIN a potom nastavte odomknutie pri priblížení.
column4: Read the PIN code status and then set up proximity unlock.

column2: Connect as the scooter owner to read PIN settings.
column3: Ak chcete prečítať nastavenia kódu PIN, pripojte sa ako vlastník kolobežky.
column4: If you want to read the PIN code settings, connect as the owner of the scooter.

column2: Turn off proximity unlock before disabling its fallback PIN.
column3: Pred vypnutím kódu PIN na riadidlách vypnite odomknutie pri priblížení.
column4: Before turning off the PIN code on the handlebars, turn off proximity unlock.

column2: Read the current PIN state first.
column3: Najprv prečítajte aktuálny stav kódu PIN.
column4: First read the current PIN code status.

column2: Couldn't set it back. Nothing was changed.
column3: Vrátenie späť zlyhalo. Nič sa nezmenilo.

column2: Couldn't start the restore. Nothing was changed.
column3: Obnovenie sa nepodarilo spustiť. Nič sa nezmenilo.
column4: The restoration could not be started. Nothing changed.

column2: Accepted; state not exposed by firmware
column3: Prijaté; stav nie je z firmvéru dostupný
column4: Accepted; status is not available from the firmware

column3: Pripojenie sa stratilo pred zmenou stavu zámku
column4: The connection was lost before the lock state changed

column3: Kolobežka neposlala žiadne potvrdenie zmeny stavu zámku
column4: The scooter sent no confirmation of the lock state change
